text:
Alicia (CSM): Hey team — prepping BlueAnchor QBR for next Tue. Need consolidated token econ + 90-day spend forecast, plus a short enablement playbook. Customer called out unexpected embed spikes last month. Can FinOps + Analytics surface a conservative/expected/high scenario by EOD? cc @Rahul @Alyssa
Rahul (FinOps): On it. Clarify: do you want gross tokens (client-side) or billed tokens (what we invoice)? I'll default to billed unless you say otherwise. Will include $ estimates.
Alyssa (Analytics): Running query now. SQL snippet I'm using: ```SELECT date, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE account = 'blueanchor' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;``` will export CSV and share link when done.
Mike (AE): Quick context — BlueAnchor enabled embeddings for semantic search and an autocomplete experiment, that's the spike source. Onboarding at ~70%. Renewal in ~60 days, customer sensitivity to surprise spend.
Katie (Enablement): I can run a focused 1-hr enablement session (caching, prompt templates, quota best practices). Proposed Fri 10am PT. If we show actionable config changes they can apply immediately.
alert-bot: [automated] Spend anomaly detected for account=blueanchor: 2x week-over-week token increase (2026-03-14 -> 2026-03-20). Current alert threshold: 50k tokens/day.
Sam (Product): Suggest trialing model `v2-embed-quant` + prefix caching for stable prompt routes. Expected embed cost reduction ~30-40% in many workloads, but we'll need quality checks.
Alicia (CSM): Good. Rahul — please output three rows in the CSV: conservative / expected / high activation with token/day and $ estimates. Also include an example alert rule (threshold + webhook) we can propose to BlueAnchor.
Rahul (FinOps): Will do. ETA ~6 hours. I'll use unit cost $0.00045/token for billed estimate and add a sensitivity column.
Alyssa (Analytics): Uploaded CSV -> https://files.redwood/blueanchor-qbr-forecast.csv. Notes: median daily tokens = 24,000; two outlier days >120k tied to nightly reindex job.
Mike (AE): That reindex job was kicked off by their infra team — good to flag as ops action. I'll ask them to stagger or page results. Also raising renewal risk flag: if we don't present mitigation, they may push back on renewal price.
Katie (Enablement): I'll draft 4-slide playbook: 1) quick cache + batching config, 2) throttle & quota patterns, 3) alert config + webhook example, 4) suggested enablement agenda. Need any customer logs or example prompts from their team?
Alicia (CSM): Please ask for the query samples and the code path causing the reindex. Also capture feedback items they raised: "need clearer spend alerts" and "per-route token visibility".
Sam (Product): I'll prepare an A/B plan: route 10% traffic to `v2-embed-quant` in staging and collect embedding similarity metrics + token cost delta. If quality drop <2% we can recommend rollout.
Rahul (FinOps): Alert rule snippet for the playbook: ```if avg(tokens, 24h) > baseline*3 then notify(#cs-ops) and POST /webhooks/customer-alerts {"account":"blueanchor","reason":"spike"}``` I'll add an example baseline calculation and suggested thresholds in the CSV.
Alyssa (Analytics): Also adding a short chart of 90-day rolling token median + 95th percentile to the payload. That makes the forecast conversation less hand-wavy.
Mike (AE): I'll coordinate a freeze on any model upgrades until after the session — want to avoid surprising quality regressions during mitigation.
Alicia (CSM): Can we reconvene 3pm PT today to finalize the deck and the ask? :calendar:
Rahul (FinOps): 3pm PT works for me.
Katie (Enablement): Yep, booked.
Sam (Product): I'll be there with A/B plan notes.
Alyssa (Analytics): I'll bring the CSV + charts.
alert-bot: Note: next automated summary will post at 14:00 PT with updated token metrics.
Alicia (CSM): Thanks all — aim to have a one-pager with the forecast table + recommended alert rule + enablement invite before the 3pm sync. I'll assemble slides and circulate a draft 30m before the meeting. :thumbsup:
